notes: All 61 route elements are covered by >=1 catalog-grade work; no gaps. 8 memberships (samekbook anchors the statechart cluster; douglasspatternsc, gof, nygard, hanmer, white, ldd3, freertosbook), 37 new works, of which 31 verified against live primary/authoritative pages this session and 6 unverified (harel87, elliotthudak97, bernier01, posa4, streamingsystems, graefe94 - all blocked by 403/connection-reset on publisher/ACM/IEEE/Valve pages; no identifiers fabricated, soft fields named). Upgrades over weak naming sources: zero-copy-i-o from bare Wikipedia to LWN (Corbet 2017); sliding-window-rate-limiting from an interview-prep book to Cloudflare's engineering post. Seeds rejected with reasons: Gregory Game Engine Architecture (no route element it covers better than nystromgpp/wloka/odonnell), NVIDIA texture-atlas whitepaper and Hodgson Feature Toggles / Fowler Memory Image / javascript.info event delegation (their elements are not in this route), Kung & Morris 1995 (credit-based flow control covered at design altitude by the Reactive Streams spec; the ATM-networking naming paper parked), douglassrtcorpus (statechart elements already carried by samekbook + douglasspatternsc), IEEE 1278.1 DIS (aronson97 suffices for dead reckoning). Correction found during verification: the GGPO article is authored by Patrick Miller about Tony Cannon's netcode, not by Cannon himself. Both PVLDB-cluster elements keep the verified naming paper (akidaudataflow) plus the unverified book-length modern treatment (streamingsystems).
